name: baoyu-infographic
tagline_zh: 丢进一堆资料，它先替你分析，再挑21种版式×22种风格，直接出能发朋友圈的高密度大图。
tagline_en: Feed it raw data, it picks from 21 layouts × 22 styles, and outputs a publish-ready visual summary.
desc_en: Generate professional infographics with 21 layout types and 22 visual styles. Analyzes content, recommends layout×style combinations, and generates publication-ready infographics. Use when user asks to create "infographic", "信息图", "visual summary", "可视化", or "高密度信息大图".
why_zh: 同类只会套模板，它先理解内容再推荐组合，省掉你反复试错的时间。
why_en: Unlike template-only tools, it analyzes content first, then suggests layout-style pairs, saving trial-and-error.
